broken_claims: Thesis parenthetical 'The first time (in mushaf order, 107:2)' is factually INVERTED. In mushaf order 52:13 (At-Tur, dict index 4747) comes FIRST and is the PASSIVE; 107:2 (Al-Maʿun, index 6198) comes SECOND and is the ACTIVE. The active occurrence is the SECOND, not first, by mushaf order.
why_survives: The load-bearing payoff — one root, two verb tokens, active (107:2) vs passive (52:13), same lemma, one intensifying cognate-accusative noun — is verified EXACT against the corpus. The moral symmetry ('the gesture you aim at the orphan is the gesture aimed at you') is order-INDEPENDENT: it holds regardless of textual sequence. The false mushaf-order phrase is a decorative anchor, not structural — striking it leaves the thesis fully standing on the dunya→akhira deed/recompense logic. Therefore the error is a mandatory correction, not a load-bearing failure.
required_corrections: 1) MANDATORY: Remove or fix the false 'in mushaf order, 107:2 is first' claim. In mushaf order the PASSIVE (52:13, At-Tur) comes first and the ACTIVE (107:2, Al-Maʿun) second. Either (a) drop the textual-ordering parenthetical entirely and let the 'you shove → you get shoved' sequence rest on its true axis — the theological deed-now/recompense-later sequence (dunya → Judgment Day), which needs no verse order; or (b) if ordering is kept, label it revelation chronology (Al-Maʿun early Makkan precedes At-Tur) AND flag that revelation order is not canonical/certain (a Quran-only purist will object to leaning on it). Option (a) is strongly preferred. 2) The title/thesis word 'then' must be tied explicitly to life→Judgment-Day, not to textual position, so no body copy re-introduces the inverted-order error. 3) MINOR: 'rough, physical verb for shoving with the hand' is a lexicon/tafsir gloss (Lane: دَعّ = thrust/push away with violence), not corpus-derivable — keep it but present as classical lexical meaning, not a morphological output.
